conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: 78800 gsf as total building area; 34000 gsf as project scope area
conflict_flags.rationale: The 78,800 SF figure from the cost estimate represents the total building footprint used for cost estimation (the study examined the entire building NH-139). The 34,000 SF in the DB RFP building requirements appears to be the area directly affected by or relevant to the power replacement scope, not the total building area. The SAES and study text both describe the full 2-story + penthouse building, consistent with 78,800 SF. Both values are recorded. Minor severity because the distinction is explainable.

claims.context: MILCON project cost/program amount from DD Form 1391; ECC $3,600,000 for backup power replacement scope
ROM estimate for full HVAC and electrical system replacement as recommended by study

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: Both values retained; they represent different scopes
conflict_flags.rationale: The $3.6-3.9M is the authorized MILCON funding for the discrete backup power replacement project (P-1401: Generator #3, UPS systems, PLCs). The $25.8M ROM is the study's estimate for comprehensive replacement of ALL aging HVAC and electrical systems across the entire building - a much larger future capital program. The study was commissioned to identify the full scope of needed work; the authorized MILCON only funds a portion. Major severity because it affects any proposal use of this project's 'value' - users must distinguish between the funded project value (~$3.9M) and the study-identified need ($25.8M).
